visual.detail: Manager must inspect all views for placement, proportions, missing/extra parts and visible intersections
visual.observation: Printed top face down on the point-16 lane axis, cocoa brown tone. Top: a clean annular sector - two straight sides and one smooth outer arc at the wide end, with no notch, scallop, bay or shortening cut anywhere into that edge. Front: the flat print face on the bed, the 1.0 mm lapping lip stepping down at the outer end, and the radial locating key standing proud on the up-facing side; all one solid, uniform 2.8 mm over the seated part. Iso: proportions match a 63.35 x 22.35 x 4.0 mm tile; nothing floats, nothing intersects, nothing is missing or extra.
